changes: Documented and validated the assumed #8 MatchDecision signature and the #9 WorkflowEnvelope and AuditEvent signatures. The HiGHS solver and the Mastra workflow are not implemented.
Added Better Auth session roles candidate, employer, and counselor, and enforced them on draft, correction, approval, rejection, submission, and interview progression.
Generated CV, cover letter, and application drafts by copying declared evidence and match-gap text only.
Required candidate approval before submission, counselor approval for critical gaps, unverified credentials, bias alerts, or infeasible transport, and employer approval before interview progression.
Rejected unauthorized submission and any payload that contains the Certo token, provider keys, or database URLs.
Made submission idempotent and appended an audit event with actor, role, timestamp, reason, and traceId for every approval, correction, rejection, and submission.
Added a node:22-alpine image, Playwright path coverage, and Vercel/Neon backup configuration.

validation.notes: 96/96 unit tests passed. Coverage 93.59% lines / 84.35% branches. Playwright passed both role-path specs. The Alpine container answered GET /health with databaseMode memory. npm audit at install time reported 0 vulnerabilities.

riskRemaining: Match decisions and workflow envelopes are assumed contracts from open issues #8 and #9. Neon is selected as the backup target, but this process does not open a live database connection. Better Auth is represented by its session.user.role signature rather than a hosted auth database.
